rationale: The report is a post-hoc sanitised security advisory, not a bug report: it gives user impact, affected versions and a one-line 'RESOLUTION DETAILS' and deliberately withholds the mechanism. No log line, no trace, no field and no function is named, and all nine gold diffs render as '(no diff retrieved)'. With nothing to cite, every role would be a guess, so all nine are unclear per rubric rule on unverifiable labels.
notes: NO-DIFF-IN-PACKET: every gold file in this packet renders its diff as '(no diff retrieved)', so there is no diff evidence for any role here. Roles rest on the issue report and the gold file list alone, which is weaker than every previously labelled instance. The report is a sanitised security advisory, which withholds the mechanism by design; that is separate from the missing diff and would make this instance hard even with a diff. Nine gold files span three layers (wire message parsing, cursor caches on both mongod and mongos, and a packet-sniffing tool), and the single non-source file among them, src/mongo/tools/sniffer.cpp, is the kind of tool adaptation CONVENTIONS calls refactor. What would settle it: the diff for dbmessage.cpp and message.h, which would show whether a length or bounds check was corrected there (causal) or whether the validation was added at the response-building site (preventive).
